conclusion: Native and WASM event/PDU counts agree, but per-event times differ even when the native run uses the WASM simulator MAC. Scheduling quantum is a possible explanation, unverified.
native_command: target/release/esp32sim-c3 --boot rom --rom web/wasm/fw/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf --flash-mb 4 --bootloader web/wasm/fw/public/c3-ble-bootloader.bin --ptable web/wasm/fw/public/c3-ble-ptable.bin --app web/wasm/fw/public/c3-ble-advertiser.bin --ble full --ble-observe --max-seconds 2 --no-dump [--mac 3c:84:27:b6:a7:1c]
mac_note: The optional MAC is a simulator default, not a captured hardware address.
